    Walks in block quivers #

    A letter l traverses from position p to q if l = a and a moves p to q, or l = a⁻¹ and a moves q to p. Following a list of letters from p either succeeds (walk), or stops at a letter with no traversal: it dies at a direct letter and fails at an inverse letter. Transports of position sets are described by walks (ptrs_iff), and a position lies in h⁺ but not in h⁻ exactly when the walk along h succeeds and cannot be continued (mem_plus_not_minus_fin, mem_plus_not_minus_inf).
